dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Mingxing Jewelry is well established within the industry, even if we are only taking advance orders on gems right now. We do have some other items in stock however.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have on offer?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Other than gems, a few odds and ends. Are you a traveler? Perhaps I have something that could be of use to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're only taking advance orders on gems?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: I do apologize for the inconvenience. We often find ourselves unable to meet the demand for our goods here at Mingxing Jewelry...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: As you will already know, Liyue is famed for its ceramics — they can only be fired locally due to the unique properties of the soil here.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Some would go so far as to say that Mingxing Jewelry is in a league of its own in the trade. Wealthy merchants will travel from all corners of Teyvat just to purchase a single Lucent Crescent from us. It is the quintessential Liyue ornament.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: We were caught by surprise when the mines at the Chasm were closed. All of a sudden, we had no suppliers.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: As you can see, only a few display items remain in stock. Though if you were to insist on buying one, the price would be... Hmm, forget it. Hearing the figure would only upset you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Mingxing Jewelry.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Mingxing Jewelry is a Liyue trader of precious stones and gems that has been around for hundreds of years.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: You could say it is the Rex Lapis of the market for precious stones. It is the only store of its kind, and it has been in business continuously since the day it was founded.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Have you ever heard anyone mention our Lucent Crescent ornaments? They are especially popular with young people.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: We produce a very limited quantity of Lucent Crescent — only ten per month. People say that if you manage to purchase one of them, you are sure to win the heart of your beloved...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Interested? Heh... Whether what they say is true or not I don't know, but I do know that I, personally, would be won over if someone was to buy one for me...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Take care. Once our stocks recover I will be sure to inform our regular customers.
